105778.aligns: Denji slowly takes on responsibility for others, and the story condemns a leader who controls people by deciding what they may want.
105778.concerns: The good life is pictured mostly as appetite: good food, comfort and romance. Building a future or a family line plays little part.

101517.aligns: A teacher invests in his students so the next generation can reform a broken system, and grit and duty are honored.
101517.concerns: The old sorcerer clans, the closest thing to family Houses here, are shown as cruel and controlling, and the tone often leans toward grim fatalism.

30002.aligns: Guts endures by sheer grit, refuses to give up against fate, and learns to protect the people beside him. Indulgence and cruelty are shown as hollow.
30002.concerns: Despair is heavy for long stretches, religious institutions are corrupt, and the story is unfinished, so building a lasting future stays out of reach.

30013.aligns: Inherited will passed down through generations is a core theme, each island keeps its own culture, and science is shown improving lives when not hoarded by rulers.
30013.concerns: The ideal is a free, adventurous life chasing a personal dream; settled family life and raising children are not what the crew seeks.

53390.aligns: Soldiers give everything so the next generation can live, and the story rejects a plan to end a people by stopping future births.
53390.concerns: Freedom is pursued through mass destruction, and the mood is often bleak, leaving the cost of building a future painfully uncertain.

87216.aligns: Disciplined training, sacrifice and passing your will to the next generation are the heart of the story; family lines carry duty forward and the peace won is for descendants.
87216.concerns: No real conflict with these values.

63327.aligns: Kaneki tries to keep his humanity and protect others when caught between two hostile sides.
63327.concerns: A medical experiment is the source of Kaneki's suffering, and the story's world is mostly cruelty and despair with little built for a future.

34632.aligns: It shows plainly how much damage neglect and broken homes do, and the people who keep going are given some quiet dignity.
34632.concerns: Family is shown mainly as a source of harm, and despair, self-destruction and a sense that life is pointless dominate the story's view of growing up.

85486.aligns: Deku earns an inherited power through relentless training, mentors pass their legacy to students, and heroism sold as a commercial brand is criticized.
85486.concerns: A father who marries to breed a more powerful child is shown as abusive, so choosing children for traits is cast in a dark light.

74347.aligns: Saitama lives frugally and helps people without needing fame, Genos works hard to improve, and his cyborg body shows technology serving good.
74347.concerns: Saitama's power came easily and he drifts in boredom, so the story says little about building toward a future or family.

30656.aligns: Musashi's growth comes through hard, disciplined practice, letting go of ego and learning self-control; strength used only for the self is shown as empty.
30656.concerns: The search is a solitary spiritual one; family, children and building something for the next generation are not central.

108556.aligns: Building a family, however imperfect, and protecting the peace so children can grow up safe is the story's driving purpose; Loid works hard for a child's future.
108556.concerns: It is a light comedy, so the family is formed by circumstance and the series does not deeply explore family culture or legacy.

30642.aligns: Thorfinn turns from revenge to patient, hard labor, building a farm and a new settlement where people can raise families in peace.
30642.concerns: Strict pacifism sometimes sits uneasily with practical defense of a community, and much of the story is spent in violence before the turn.

87423.aligns: Clever children plan, train and outthink a system that treats them as livestock, and older siblings take responsibility for the younger ones.
87423.concerns: The main mother figure serves the system that exploits the children, so parenthood is shown through a dark lens for much of the story.

106130.aligns: Players earn greatness through hunger, honest self-analysis and constant adaptation; competence is fought for, never handed out.
106130.concerns: Success is framed around the self-centered ego, with teammates as rivals to outdo, and family or legacy has no real role.

72451.aligns: Hori runs her household and looks after her little brother, and the story values steady, everyday care and commitment in a relationship.
72451.concerns: The emphasis is on being accepted as you are, more than on discipline, building a future or passing anything on.

30012.aligns: Ichigo protects his family and friends and trains hard to do it, and fear and death are faced with courage.
30012.concerns: Science appears mostly through cold, amoral experimenters, and the action-driven story says little about family culture or building for the future.

86635.aligns: Shirogane is a relentless worker who earns everything he has, and wealth and status are shown as poor substitutes for honest bonds.
86635.concerns: The one family dynasty shown is cold and controlling, and the story treats escaping family authority as part of the happy ending.

102988.aligns: Takemichi refuses to give up on people and keeps trying to fix the future through persistence and loyalty.
102988.concerns: Much of the energy goes into gang loyalty and street fights, and the story says little about work, family building or long-term legacy.

132029.aligns: Friends stand by each other and protect the vulnerable, and a grandmother's guidance and practical help are honored.
132029.concerns: It is mostly an energetic occult adventure; discipline, technology and building for the next generation play only a small part.

30026.aligns: Characters grow through intense training and clever strategy, and the story warns how obsession and revenge consume people.
30026.concerns: The main family House shown is a coercive assassin clan the hero's friend must escape, and Gon's own father chose adventure over raising him.

30003.aligns: Ordinary adults take responsibility for the world's future, raise a child left in their care, and stand against a cult built on fantasy.
30003.concerns: Science and technology are mainly tools of a doomsday cult, and the story focuses more on nostalgia than on building something new.

86123.aligns: Asta has no magic and earns his place through endless training and refusal to quit, lifting up others the system looks down on.
86123.concerns: The story's family is a found group of misfits; raising children and building a family line are not part of its vision.

30001.aligns: A doctor's persistence against a figure who preaches meaninglessness affirms that every life is worth saving and nihilism is defeated.
30001.concerns: Experiments in shaping children through engineered upbringing are shown as horror, and family is often a site of cruelty.

117195.aligns: A mother's love for her children is honored, and the story exposes how fame and online crowds consume young people.
117195.concerns: The tone is bleak, revenge drives much of the plot, and the story offers little picture of a stable family or building for the future.

97852.aligns: Patient effort to reach out to others, however clumsy, is rewarded.
97852.concerns: A gentle school comedy about friendship; it says little about discipline, family culture, technology or the future.

120760.aligns: Kafka keeps a childhood promise at 32 through hard work and humble effort, and kaiju-derived technology protects people.
120760.concerns: Kafka's breakthrough comes from a sudden power he did not earn, and family or legacy play only a small role.

31706.aligns: Johnny grows through his own hard effort, and Gyro carries a family tradition and skill handed down from his father.
31706.concerns: The journey is largely about personal fulfillment, and the story is suspicious of any national cause that asks for sacrifice.

87170.aligns: It condemns people who use others as tools, and characters search hard for a reason to keep living.
87170.concerns: The world is frozen and starving, purposes are mostly roles people invent to cope, and life is often shown as absurd and pointless.

85611.aligns: Kaneki turns toward protecting a coming child and building a shared future, and a character who embraces nihilism is defeated.
85611.concerns: Medical experiments and state science are shown as dehumanizing, and absurdism runs through much of the story.

65243.aligns: Players grow through hard practice, losses become fuel for growth, and Hinata earns his skill by deliberate, humble training.
65243.concerns: The focus stays on sport; family, children and legacy are not part of its message.

101583.aligns: Gojo treats a craft he learned from his grandfather with patience and care, and dedicated work on costumes is admired.
101583.concerns: The good life is framed around enjoying your hobbies without shame, with consumer fan culture celebrated.

30021.aligns: Taking the power to judge who should die corrupts the one who seizes it, and clear-eyed cunning is central.
30021.concerns: A cat-and-mouse thriller; it says little about family, work, technology or the next generation.

30011.aligns: Naruto rises from outcast through perseverance and training, and the village's will passed from one generation to the next is central.
30011.concerns: Bloodline powers often outweigh effort, and one clan's rigid family rules are shown as oppressive.

100994.aligns: Gabimaru fights to return to his wife, and an immortality bought by harvesting people is rejected.
100994.concerns: The pursuit of longer life is shown mostly as monstrous, and the ideal is a quiet personal life more than building something lasting.

85135.aligns: Shoya owns serious harm he did, makes amends and works to rebuild his life; despair is shown as something to overcome, not accept.
85135.concerns: Family and building toward the future stay in the background of a story about personal healing.

125828.aligns: A former hitman chooses family life, runs a store with his wife and daughter, and protects them; the family is his purpose.
125828.concerns: A comedic action series, so the family's culture and the child's upbringing are a backdrop more than a theme.

98416.aligns: Senku rebuilds civilization from scratch through science, patient hard work and teaching others, and the knowledge is shared so everyone can live better.
98416.concerns: No real conflict with these values.

31133.aligns: Characters keep their word to their own people and do honest work, like running a restaurant.
31133.concerns: Absurdist tone and a focus on daily pleasures leave little room for building toward a future, discipline or family legacy.

30436.aligns: Loyalty between people who love each other is the one thing that holds out longest.
30436.concerns: The universe is shown as indifferent and every effort, including escape, ends the same way, so despair is close to the story's final word.

146983.aligns: Making art through steady effort is shown as a way to carry loss forward.
146983.concerns: The story centers on grief and on self-expression through film, and it says little about family, legacy or building for the future.

118586.aligns: Frieren learns that deeds and kindness last across generations, teachers pass skills to students, and Fern grows through diligent study.
118586.concerns: A quiet, reflective story; children and family lines are not part of its focus.

97553.aligns: A person's worth is shown not to lie in market value, and Kusunoki grows through kindness and honest effort.
97553.concerns: The closing choice favors a short, happy stretch over a longer future, and the story leaves open whether that is fulfillment or surrender.

98263.aligns: Magic works like a craft that must be learned through study and discipline, and it is used to help people, including those with disabilities.
98263.concerns: Some knowledge is kept forbidden for safety, and the story is still weighing whether that caution is wise.

74489.aligns: Phos changes and grows through hard, painful effort, and the story questions rigid authority.
74489.concerns: The story moves toward a longing for release and ending rather than growth or continuation, and much of it is steeped in despair.

140475.aligns: Rintaro works in his family's bakery and studies hard for someone he cares about, and divisions between two schools are bridged with patience.
140475.concerns: A gentle romance; discipline and family carry it, but legacy and the future are only lightly touched.

30025.aligns: Science is honored as a discipline, prosthetic technology improves lives, and hard work, owning mistakes and giving back are rewarded.
30025.concerns: Trying to overcome human limits, such as death, is shown as dangerous hubris.

107237.aligns: Yatora chooses his path and earns his skill through long hours of deliberate practice and honest self-assessment.
107237.concerns: Living as your true self is a central goal, and family, legacy and the next generation play a small role.

46765.aligns: Shin rises from nothing through grit, and the story honors sacrifice for a peace meant to last for generations.
46765.concerns: Its goal is uniting every state under one ruler and law, which is in tension with many distinct cultures living side by side.

100664.aligns: Senpai grows braver through his art and through effort, and hiding from others is outgrown.
100664.concerns: A teasing romantic comedy; it says little about family, work or the future.

30051.aligns: Talent only matters after humble basics and hard practice, and delinquents turn their lives around through discipline and team commitment.
30051.concerns: The focus stays on sport and a single season; family and legacy are not part of the message.

37375.aligns: Mori pushes himself through extreme discipline and self-denial, and in the end a family draws him back to life.
37375.concerns: For most of the story, obsessive solo achievement eclipses everything and everyone else.

54705.aligns: Kasuga eventually outgrows a destructive fantasy of escape and starts building an ordinary, responsible life.
54705.concerns: Much of the story dwells on rebellion and self-destruction, with little on work, family or the future until late.

30936.aligns: It exposes how people hide behind money, rank and appearance.
30936.concerns: A medical procedure is the gateway to a dark psychological spiral, and the story offers a bleak view of whether a person can be healed.

33009.aligns: Jolyne reconciles with her father and fights for family and friends, and a family line carries courage across generations.
33009.concerns: Self-discipline that accepts a fixed fate is criticized, and the closing note is more about hope than building.

169355.aligns: Chihiro carries forward his swordsmith father's craft and legacy, and disciplined training is rewarded.
169355.concerns: Revenge is a central motive, so the drive is as much about settling a score as building for the future.

105469.aligns: Yuta finds courage and purpose through friendship and training, and a plan to wipe out ordinary people in favor of the gifted is rejected.
105469.concerns: A short action story; work, family and building for the next generation get little attention.

98842.aligns: Easy wishes that make someone else pay are rejected, and characters face guilt honestly.
98842.concerns: A supernatural school story with little to say about discipline, family culture or the future.

30564.aligns: Selfishness and pleasure-seeking are shown as ugly, while Kei grows to protect others at real cost to himself.
30564.concerns: The universe is shown as indifferent, human life often seems cheap, and building for a future rarely enters the picture.

100230.aligns: Futaro studies hard to lift his poor family, the sisters learn through effort, and loyalty to family and lifelong marriage are honored.
100230.concerns: A romantic comedy built on rivalry for one boy; its fit is light.

30908.aligns: Sound mind and sound body is the school's ideal, and courage and trust between partners defeat madness.
30908.concerns: Science shows up mostly through unstable or cruel experimenters, and family and legacy are minor.

87395.aligns: Friends push each other out of their comfort zones and learn the discipline of diving.
87395.concerns: Heavy drinking and partying are the center of its comedy, and youth is framed mainly as a time for fun.

107098.aligns: Humanity proves its worth through grit and achievement, and scientific ingenuity is celebrated as a human triumph.
107098.concerns: It is a tournament spectacle; family and building for the future are mostly absent.

144946.aligns: Repairing and cherishing things rather than discarding them is the core value, and consumer waste is criticized.
144946.concerns: The story frames society in terms of the powerful oppressing the discarded, and family and legacy stay in the background.

101233.aligns: Tatsu brings skill, pride and thrift to housework, hunting bargains and cooking with care, and leaves a violent past behind.
101233.concerns: A light comedy with no children; its fit is mostly in its respect for home and frugality.

30583.aligns: Comrades stay loyal and refuse to be used as weapons, choosing solidarity over power.
30583.concerns: Experimenting on people to make warriors is shown as monstrous, and the bleak world offers little vision of family or future.

98397.aligns: It shows clearly how a parent's control can harm a child.
98397.concerns: The parent-child bond is shown mainly as a trap, and the story offers little picture of a healthy family or a hopeful future.

86218.aligns: Touko learns to stop living as a copy of someone else, and love is shown as helping a person grow.
86218.concerns: The good life is framed mainly around living as your true self, with family, work and legacy in the background.

30149.aligns: Killy's long, stoic persistence aims to restore humanity's control over a runaway world-machine.
30149.concerns: Technology is mostly shown as having escaped human control, and the world is bleak and nearly empty of family life.

111233.aligns: Honesty about one's feelings and staying loyal at a cost are valued.
111233.concerns: Skipping school and drifting through the night are framed as freedom, and fitting into ordinary duties is shown as stifling.

86310.aligns: Firefighters keep hope against despair and treat their team as family, and engineering skill helps save lives.
86310.concerns: Religious institutions are shown mostly as tools of control, and family culture and the next generation are minor.

136807.aligns: Fujino's art grows through years of hard practice, and loss is carried forward into continued work.
136807.concerns: Family and building something for the next generation are not part of this short story's focus.

86717.aligns: Characters hold steady jobs and support each other patiently.
86717.concerns: The good life is framed around sharing hobbies and being accepted, with little about discipline or the future.

30104.aligns: A father raises a curious child with care, and the neighbors help her learn about the world through everyday experience.
30104.concerns: A gentle comedy; discipline, legacy and building for the future are not themes.

79865.aligns: Kei learns to value particular human bonds, and clever, clear-eyed problem-solving is central.
79865.concerns: Lab science is shown mostly as dehumanizing, and the world is cold and cruel.

55515.aligns: Josuke helps a family House with its own traditions break a curse, and greed for shortcuts is shown destroying families.
55515.concerns: A medical miracle sought as a shortcut is shown as dangerous, and the family is often a place of secrets and rivalry.

54692.aligns: Yato turns from a violent past and takes responsibility for the people bound to him.
54692.concerns: A supernatural action story with little to say about work, family culture or the future.

86399.aligns: Rimuru builds a nation where different peoples keep their ways and live together, with roads, industry and innovation improving everyone's life.
86399.concerns: The hero's strength comes from a gift at rebirth rather than effort, so competence is often given rather than earned.

99943.aligns: Chizuru works hard toward her acting goals while caring for her grandmother, and lies are eventually faced.
99943.concerns: A romance built on a paid service, with long stretches of indecision rather than growth.

54294.aligns: Characters face grief honestly instead of hiding from it.
54294.concerns: A school romance focused on emotional honesty; it says little about discipline, family culture or the future.

114960.aligns: Mash earns his strength through daily training and protects his adoptive father, judging people by deeds rather than birth.
114960.concerns: A parody with little focus on building a future, and simple pleasures are a big part of Mash's ideal life.

30028.aligns: The cost of running from loneliness through sex, drugs and dependence is shown plainly, and a young mother takes up responsibility.
30028.concerns: Romantic and creative dreams dominate, family life is often shown as a disappointment, and the story is unfinished.

116186.aligns: Reiji chooses to keep living and to face hard truths rather than give in to despair.
116186.concerns: Family duty and hometown are shown mainly as traps to escape, and despair hangs over most of the story.

86551.aligns: Riko's drive to explore the unknown, following her mother's legacy, honors curiosity and the push outward whatever the cost.
86551.concerns: Scientific research is shown through cruel experiments on children, and the world is indifferent to human suffering.

33031.aligns: Oz chooses to keep going for the people he loves, and old noble Houses with their own traditions are central to the world.
33031.concerns: Family Houses are often places of secrets and harm, and the focus is personal identity more than building for the future.

30598.aligns: Members get stronger for each other's sake and forgive former enemies.
30598.concerns: Friendship wins most battles more than discipline, and the guild family is about belonging more than building for the next generation.

61499.aligns: Raku aims for honest work rather than the family business, and loyalty and kindness are valued.
61499.concerns: A romantic comedy with little to say about discipline, family culture or the future.

86082.aligns: Practical, clear-eyed problem-solving, thrift and self-sufficiency drive the party, who live off the dungeon's ecosystem.
86082.concerns: Eternal life and unchecked desire are shown as dangerous, which sits slightly against openness to life extension.

30336.aligns: Onizuka works hard to save troubled students, often repairing broken families along the way.
30336.concerns: Onizuka's crude, impulsive behavior is played for comedy, and schools and authority are often shown as hollow.

132182.aligns: Taiki trains every morning to get better, giving full effort so he will have no regrets.
132182.concerns: A sports romance; family, legacy and building for the future are minor.

106064.aligns: Diligence, loyalty and protecting the weak are valued.
106064.concerns: Physical pleasure is framed as the reward for hard work, which conflicts with self-control and the rejection of self-indulgence.

85849.aligns: Arata returns to work and life after dropping out of society, and a scientific program gives him a real second chance.
85849.concerns: The focus is personal recovery; family and building for the future are not central.

74485.aligns: Loyal love and friendship are honored across clan and racial lines.
74485.concerns: Romance and loyalty win more battles than discipline, and building a lasting future is not explored.

33731.aligns: Meiko keeps going after loss and finds purpose in hard work on her music.
33731.concerns: Quitting a stable job to chase a dream is framed sympathetically, and family and the next generation are absent.

69883.aligns: A teacher invests everything in raising students well, helping each discover and build their own strength through hard work.
69883.concerns: Lab experiments on people are shown as the source of horror and suffering.

51525.aligns: Yona turns privilege into service and learns to fight, and she works to heal the land through practical help.
51525.concerns: Family and legacy appear mostly as burdens, through ancient bloodline duties, and the ideal is personal service.

30042.aligns: Goku's joy in training shows strength earned through discipline, and Bulma's inventions show technology improving life.
30042.concerns: Fighting is enjoyed for its own sake, and family and the next generation are minor in this early series.

149544.aligns: Friends back each other's dreams and put real work into making music.
149544.concerns: The good life is framed mainly around living openly as yourself, with family, work and the future in the background.

30745.aligns: Robots and AI are shown as moral beings capable of love and family, and the cycle of hatred is rejected.
30745.concerns: Advanced technology is also turned into weapons of war, and the story weighs grief-driven creation with caution.

33986.aligns: Ganta refuses to become a monster and chooses mercy and life after injustice.
33986.concerns: Science appears mainly as lab cruelty, and the world is cold and cynical, with little picture of family or a future.

86559.aligns: Survival skill, hard-won competence and Asirpa's resolve to carry the Ainu way of life into a new era show a distinct culture choosing its own future.
86559.concerns: Most of the cast chase gold, revenge or a lost war, and family-building stays in the background of a long manhunt.

97830.aligns: Fushi grows by learning skills and lessons from each person he meets, and a lineage of protectors carries his story across generations.
97830.concerns: Loss and letting go are the main lessons, and endless life is treated more as a burden than as a chance to build.

85412.aligns: Two girls keep their curiosity, kindness and small rituals alive while exploring a ruined world.
85412.concerns: There is no future to build here: humanity is ending, its technology lies in ruins, and the story settles into calm acceptance of that.

30657.aligns: Disabled athletes rebuild their lives through daily training and honest effort, and worth comes from the work you put in now, not past status.
30657.concerns: No real conflict with these values.

126693.aligns: Tokio learns to find his own will and use new powers to protect others, and power fed by raw desire is shown as dangerous.
126693.concerns: The story centers on self-discovery and transformation, with little to say about family, work or building for the future.

38967.aligns: A boy's secret self-indulgence and contempt for others lead him into cruelty and isolation, and he recovers by owning his wrongs and changing.
38967.concerns: Its focus on a teen's private compulsions gives little positive picture of family or purpose beyond personal redemption.

44790.aligns: Heroes work to build lasting trade, alliances and institutions so that peoples can live free, and reject a fixed fate handed down from above.
44790.concerns: Its push toward one shared world order sits uneasily with the tradition's preference for many separate cultures, and magic-tech is often shown as exploiting the poor.

87178.aligns: Boruto carries his father's legacy and protects his family and village, learning that strength must be earned rather than borrowed.
87178.concerns: Science-ninja tools and body enhancement are often framed as cheats or threats, so technology reads more as danger than progress.

85189.aligns: Mob learns that talent is not what makes a person; daily training, self-control over his powers and how he treats others matter more.
85189.concerns: No real conflict with these values.

98587.aligns: Legoshi learns to master his predator instincts through deliberate self-restraint, and his own mixed family line shows a lineage worth understanding.
98587.concerns: Much of the story is about identity and forbidden romance across species lines, and sexual appetite is a recurring theme without much framing around family.

55132.aligns: A decadent, cruel capital that lives for luxury is condemned, and the heroes sacrifice themselves to build a better nation for those who come after.
55132.concerns: The story is mostly about killing and loss, with little attention to family, work or what is built once the fighting ends.

31517.aligns: Jonathan lives by courage, self-control and sacrifice, and the Joestar bloodline begins a family legacy carried by later generations.
31517.concerns: Seeking power beyond human limits is shown only as monstrous, which leans against the tradition's openness to enhancing humanity.

106758.aligns: Cid pursues his chosen goal with total dedication and training, and his followers find purpose in a cause bigger than themselves.
106758.concerns: The goal is a self-absorbed fantasy played for laughs, so the story offers little serious message about family, work or legacy.

75757.aligns: Soma grows out of his family's diner by failing, learning and trying again, and a ruling elite that imposes one taste on everyone is defeated.
75757.concerns: The thrill of eating is played up with over-the-top pleasure reactions, putting sensory enjoyment near the center of the craft.

85564.aligns: A wasted, idle past life is shown as empty, and Rudeus works hard to rebuild and protect his family, raising children and lasting bonds.
85564.concerns: His sexual misconduct and the harm it causes others get little weight, and many choices are driven by his own desires.

99022.aligns: Maomao uses careful observation, medicine and experiment to protect people, and evidence beats rumor and superstition at court.
99022.concerns: Court luxury and intrigue around heirs are a backdrop rather than critiqued, and Maomao herself has little interest in family.

30664.aligns: Young survivors in a ruined city end up founding their own new order instead of waiting on the government that failed them.
30664.concerns: Science is shown chiefly as hubris: state experiments on children unleash destruction, and enhanced power brings only catastrophe.

85215.aligns: Keiji earns his skill by dying and repeating the same battle countless times, turning raw effort and discipline into real competence.
85215.concerns: Victory comes at a heavy personal cost, and family or building for the future is not part of the story.

86770.aligns: A caretaker raises a child not his own with patient love, and fear-driven walls and purges are shown to destroy more than they protect.
86770.concerns: The story is a quiet fable about tenderness and fear of the different, with little to say about work, progress or legacy.

85307.aligns: Outcasts find purpose in a found family that works to save people, and a past life of killing can be left behind through effort.
85307.concerns: Belonging and redemption drive the story more than building families or anything lasting for the next generation.

86300.aligns: Loyal friendship and patient honesty are rewarded in a light school romance.
86300.concerns: The message is about being accepted as you are, with nothing much about family, work or the future.

105097.aligns: Miko shows steady self-control, hiding her fear to protect family and friends, and learns compassion for the troubled spirits she sees.
105097.concerns: It is a light horror comedy, so it speaks to these values only in small ways.

147149.aligns: Small kindnesses and daily rituals help a worn-out office worker, and honest connection is shown to matter more than appearances.
147149.concerns: Work is mainly a drain to recover from, and comfort and small indulgences, like the shared smoke break, are offered as the answer.

98328.aligns: Desire indulged without restraint turns people into literal monsters, a strong warning against hedonism.
98328.concerns: The hero also rejects the settled script of job, marriage and family as hollow, without offering a better path to family life.

150378.aligns: Troubleshooters in a rough district solve problems practically and protect their neighbors.
150378.concerns: An action series about protecting a community, with little to say about family, work or legacy.

73661.aligns: Characters are loyal to their found family, and experiments that turn children into weapons are condemned.
73661.concerns: Ruling families and their science are shown as using people as tools, and the story offers little picture of a future worth building.

39711.aligns: Two boys reach their goal through relentless work, clever strategy and learning a demanding industry, carrying on an uncle's unfinished dream.
39711.concerns: The dream is personal fame in manga, and long overwork is sometimes shown as costing their health.

138603.aligns: Choosing to stay loyal to someone you love even when he is strange and frightening is shown as brave.
138603.concerns: A village's old customs are shown mainly as cover for hidden sins that crush those who do not fit, casting inherited community ways in a dark light.

85802.aligns: The lead works hard at his writing craft, and the story ends in marriage after costly choices.
85802.concerns: Following one's heart past family and social limits is the main lesson, including an affair with a teacher and romance between step-siblings.

30024.aligns: Allen keeps moving forward through grief and refuses to undo death, staying loyal to the people who become his home.
30024.concerns: The Order's experiments on children are shown as monstrous, and institutions and their science are mostly framed as failing those they claim to serve.

43492.aligns: Rin loves the father who raised him and trains hard to become an exorcist, earning his place despite his heritage.
43492.concerns: Its key message is that bloodline does not define you, and secret research programs are shown as dangerous and cruel.

38848.aligns: Ken uses his strength to protect the weak and keeps faith with those who follow him, building an organization from nothing.
38848.concerns: Much of the story is set in a crime world, and fan-service and gang life are treated with more enjoyment than criticism.

85911.aligns: Friendship beats greed in deadly games, and Yuichi wins through cunning and close reading of people rather than raw strength.
85911.concerns: The hero's winning method is manipulation and lies, and the games put money and survival ahead of any larger purpose.

44440.aligns: Small acts of care and empathy are valued over heroic posturing in a collapsing society.
44440.concerns: Survival comes mostly by luck rather than effort, society never rebuilds, and the story ends on loneliness and doubt about whether surviving is worth it.

112981.aligns: Being noticed and valued by one person helps a shy boy find friends and the courage to speak up.
112981.concerns: A gentle romance comedy with little to say about family, work or the future.

30912.aligns: The story shows obsession with beauty and possession as destructive, turning ordinary people into killers.
30912.concerns: It offers no hope or cure: the evil returns endlessly, and the only survivors are those who simply avoid it.

101177.aligns: A couple marries first and builds love through daily faithfulness and small kindnesses, treating commitment as the foundation.
101177.concerns: Children and a wider family culture are not a focus, and the story is mostly light romantic comedy.

63031.aligns: Despair, cynicism and the Beach's pleasure-seeking all lead nowhere, and Arisu learns to fight for life with the friends who sacrificed for him.
63031.concerns: Family and building for the future are outside the story's survival-game focus.

85316.aligns: Lifelong friendship and seeing the human face of supposed enemies are prized, and fear-mongering media and leaders are distrusted.
85316.concerns: The story leans toward despairing satire of society, and military technology is shown mostly as a tool of panic and violence.

107282.aligns: A couple supports and protects each other in a steady partnership.
107282.concerns: A light romance about accepting each other, with little about family, work or legacy.

87347.aligns: Grief is faced honestly and turned into music that can be given to others.
87347.concerns: The story centers on personal romance and self-expression, with little about family-building or work beyond the band.

98334.aligns: Honesty with friends is valued, and the story follows its characters into adult commitments.
98334.concerns: Its central message is being true to one's identity and desires against others' expectations, which the tradition does not see as the main point of a life.

41054.aligns: The story warns against power that feeds on greed and manipulation, and hopes creative work can be used to do good.
41054.concerns: A cosmic conspiracy steering history leaves human effort looking small, and the message is murky rather than clearly about building or family.

33008.aligns: Giorno and his team work with discipline and loyalty to protect the weak and dismantle a drug trade preying on children.
33008.concerns: They work inside a criminal organization, and fate is shown as largely fixed rather than shaped by effort.

114416.aligns: Honesty and care for everyone in the group are rewarded, and no one is left out.
114416.concerns: A comic romance about one boy's ever-growing set of girlfriends, its focus is romantic fulfillment rather than family or work.

65573.aligns: Friends learn to act before it is too late, and despair is fought by people who refuse to let a friend go.
65573.concerns: Romance and teen friendship are central, with only a light touch on family or building for the future.

30698.aligns: Shinji chooses to live among other people, accepting the pain that comes with them, instead of dissolving into a merged painless whole.
30698.concerns: Parents and their science are shown mostly as damaging, and despair and isolation dominate most of the story.

109501.aligns: Getting back up after heartbreak and choosing a faithful, honest partner are rewarded.
109501.concerns: Gaming as leisure is the social world of the story, and family or work hardly figure.

33866.aligns: Ciel shows iron self-control, runs a business and keeps his word, and the story condemns those who prey on children.
33866.concerns: His life is aimed entirely at revenge and ends in a bargain for his soul, leaving no future, family or legacy.

99324.aligns: Iruma grows through effort at school, kindness to others and the love of the adoptive grandfather who raises him.
99324.concerns: It is a light comedy, and its moral is more about being cared for and kindness than about discipline or building.

55297.aligns: Friends stay loyal through any humiliation and keep their word.
55297.concerns: The comedy is built on the boys' lechery and fan-service, and its message is mostly that rigid authority is absurd.

33378.aligns: Sincerity, patience and slow respectful love win over loneliness and misunderstanding.
33378.concerns: A sweet school romance with little to say about work, building or the future.

105011.aligns: A school program that trains students for marriage teaches that love is learned by living together and showing up daily.
105011.concerns: Fan-service and romantic drama take up much of the story, and children and family culture are not part of it.

30743.aligns: Grown men face their childhood guilt and work together to rebuild a society shaken by a cult.
30743.concerns: It looks backward at guilt more than forward to building a future or a family.

31630.aligns: Joseph wins through wit, cunning and preparation rather than raw power, and he honors those who came before him by carrying on their fight.
31630.concerns: Power beyond human limits is shown only as monstrous, which leans against openness to enhancement.

87208.aligns: A small community gives troubled people a place to belong and keeps a lonely teen alive.
87208.concerns: Its central path to a good life is self-discovery of sexual and gender identity, a progressive framing the tradition's founders often criticize.

87459.aligns: The author takes small concrete steps toward her work and stops living for others' approval, a practical road out of despair.
87459.concerns: The good life is framed mainly around self-care and self-expression, with family shown more as pressure than as something to build.

32921.aligns: Misaki works hard to support her family after her father leaves debts, and earns respect through honest effort.
32921.concerns: The main focus is a school romance, and the wealthy family drama leans on fantasy more than effort.

30004.aligns: A kind android lives a full, thoughtful life, a gentle picture of AI as a good companion.
30004.concerns: Humanity is fading and the story treats that decline with peaceful acceptance rather than any urge to rebuild.

33006.aligns: Josuke and his friends defend ordinary town life, and the villain's selfish wish for a quiet, comfortable life is shown as deeply evil.
33006.concerns: Family and work are present but not central, and the story celebrates enjoying everyday life as much as building it.

111189.aligns: Learning another person's language takes real effort, and the couple choose to commit to each other for life.
111189.concerns: Travel, romance and personal growth are the focus, with children and family culture outside the story.

101557.aligns: A boy who sneers at the world learns kindness and honesty, a clear rejection of cynicism.
101557.concerns: A light school romance, so it speaks to these values only in small ways.

86568.aligns: Characters refuse to treat anyone as a thing, and hatred and purity crusades are shown destroying those they claim to protect.
86568.concerns: Scientific experimentation is shown as cruel and dehumanizing, and little in the story looks toward family or a future.

30872.aligns: Jotaro and his allies risk everything to save his mother, and the family's courage is passed down as a heritage for the future.
30872.concerns: No real conflict with these values.

30007.aligns: A bullied boy earns his place through relentless training, strict self-denial and grit, beating gifted rivals by work alone and passing it on to others.
30007.concerns: Family life is mostly in the background of the boxing, though Ippo stays devoted to his mother's fishing business.

85165.aligns: Charles-Henri pursues medicine and humane reform from inside a hereditary job, hoping for a less cruel justice.
85165.concerns: An inherited family role is shown mainly as a cage, and breaking with family tradition is presented as the brave choice.

85442.aligns: Naofumi rebuilds a destroyed village through trade, training and practical problem-solving, protecting those in his care.
85442.concerns: He uses a slave system the story does not seriously question, and his appetite for public revenge is often celebrated.

86508.aligns: Endless training rewards effort, and Bulma's inventions show technology making life better and saving the day.
86508.concerns: Goku's love of fighting often comes before his family, and godlike rulers can erase everything on a whim.

30102.aligns: Love and acceptance heal deep family wounds, and the characters go on to form their own healthier families.
30102.concerns: An old clan's traditions are shown mainly as a curse to break, with less care for keeping what was good in them.

150440.aligns: Ruri is met halfway by friends, family and community when she stops hiding what she is.
150440.concerns: A light slice-of-life comedy about fitting in, with little about work, family-building or the future.

47465.aligns: Emanon carries the memory of all life since its beginning, and each person is shown as one link in a long chain of descendants.
47465.concerns: The stories are quiet and wistful rather than about effort, building or technology.

31224.aligns: Rei pushes through grief with disciplined shogi work and finds belonging in a warm family carrying on a generations-old sweets shop.
31224.concerns: The story stresses that effort alone does not cure depression, so it leans on care more than grit.

98235.aligns: Students put in honest effort toward goals they choose, even in their weakest subjects, and help each other reach them.
98235.concerns: Fan-service and harem romance take up much of the story.

39982.aligns: Baku wins through cunning, careful reading of people and nerve, keeping faith with his few allies.
39982.concerns: The world is one of high-stakes gambling and violence, and money and risk-taking for its own sake are the measure of a life.

113501.aligns: Two awkward people find closeness, cheered on by supportive family and friends.
113501.concerns: Mostly cozy hanging out, with little about work, discipline or building a future.

65003.aligns: A bored loner finds purpose by helping others, and honest effort is shown to count for more than shortcuts.
65003.concerns: A light supernatural romance with little to say about family or legacy.

31649.aligns: Cunning used with honesty beats a game built on greed, and cooperation saves everyone from ruin.
31649.concerns: The focus is on outwitting a money game, with nothing about family or building for the future.

112579.aligns: Shiino refuses to give up after her friend's suicide, and the story affirms that the living must go on.
112579.concerns: Grief dominates, and the story treats family mainly as the source of harm.

30145.aligns: Practice, loyalty and hard work turn a nobody into a real musician.
30145.concerns: Rock-band life and music as self-expression are the center, with family and building beyond the band in the background.

109285.aligns: Mitsumi studies hard toward a government career so she can help her shrinking rural hometown, and her family and town back her.
109285.concerns: The story's focus is on friendship and being yourself more than on that goal or on family-building.

76716.aligns: Masamune remakes himself through years of disciplined diet and exercise.
76716.concerns: His drive is revenge over a childhood insult, and looks and status are the main measures of worth.

30401.aligns: Shinichi holds on to human love and mercy, and his mother's sacrifice shows family love at its deepest.
30401.concerns: The story seriously entertains the view that humanity is a plague on the Earth, and offers no case for human growth or expansion.

47353.aligns: Two teens' sexual relationship is shown leaving them emptier, and they come out searching for something bigger.
47353.concerns: It is a bleak coming-of-age story with little picture of family or a future worth building.

80145.aligns: Persistent, honest love helps a cold, controlled girl open up.
80145.concerns: Following the heart over family duty and an arranged marriage is presented as the right choice, putting self-expression ahead of family plans.

30658.aligns: Manji and Rin keep faith with each other, and the story questions whether endless revenge can bring peace.
30658.concerns: Medical experiments to unlock immortality are shown as monstrous, and the plot is mostly a cycle of killing.

110473.aligns: Two insomniacs turn their trouble into a shared passion for astronomy and astrophotography, and stick by each other.
110473.concerns: A quiet romance, so it speaks to these values only lightly.

106867.aligns: A man fights to own and face his past rather than be defined by a parent's crimes.
106867.concerns: Heredity is framed as a dark question of violence passed down, and despair sits close to the surface.

66267.aligns: Escaping into someone else's life is shown to be no cure, and an idle shut-in existence is shown as empty.
66267.concerns: The focus is on personal identity, with little about family, work or building.

142568.aligns: Patient listening is shown to help more than quick fixes, and neglectful families are shown doing deep harm.
142568.concerns: Gadgets meant to bring happiness only make things worse, so technology reads as a false shortcut.

30044.aligns: Gintoki keeps his own code and protects those near him, and the inventor Gengai and the robot Tama show technology as helpful.
30044.concerns: Its lazy, broke hero and running jokes about idleness and gambling are celebrated as part of the comedy.

94490.aligns: A professional killer learns to hold an ordinary job and protect others without taking life.
94490.concerns: The story is a crime comedy with little to say about family or building.

43702.aligns: Learning to balance ambition with friendship and feelings is shown as growth.
43702.concerns: Shizuku's drive to study is softened rather than rewarded, and family and work are minor.

87321.aligns: Goblin Slayer wins through relentless preparation, cunning tactics and daily discipline, protecting ordinary villagers others ignore.

30768.aligns: Alita defines her own humanity through effort and choice, whatever body she lives in, and cybernetic bodies are shown as fully human.
30768.concerns: Scientists are often shown as cruel, and the floating elite city exploits the people below.

115122.aligns: Cleverness is used for profit and safety rather than to kill.
115122.concerns: The ironic ending offers little moral beyond outwitting others for money.

180752.aligns: Ichi lives by honest strength and hunting only what he needs, a thrifty, disciplined life, loyal to a chosen family.
180752.concerns: An early-stage fantasy adventure with little yet about family-building or technology.

85533.aligns: Patience and the slow growth of honest affection are rewarded.
85533.concerns: A light school comedy with little to say about work, family or the future.

41514.aligns: Families keep their own crafts, customs and hospitality across generations, and marriage and raising children are central to a full life.

30756.aligns: Loyal, selfless friendship is shown as what keeps a person human amid violence and abuse.
30756.concerns: A mind-controlling drug shows science as a weapon of the powerful, and the story ends in tragedy rather than building.

104660.aligns: Leaving an abusive job is shown as freeing, and some bucket-list goals involve helping friends and others.

86952.aligns: The heroine survives a brutal start by grinding, scheming and outthinking stronger foes, rewarding grit and cunning over raw power.
86952.concerns: Her drive is mostly personal survival and freedom; family, children or building for others matter little in the message.

30030.aligns: Scholarship student Haruhi stays thrifty and hard-working among rich classmates, and the story pokes fun at their wasteful luxury.
30030.concerns: Most of the fun is in lavish leisure and dress-up play, and the message centers on being true to oneself rather than on duty or family.

101315.aligns: Under the teasing, the romance rewards loyalty and kindness that show up in small acts.
101315.concerns: A light ecchi comedy whose engine is flirtation; little in it speaks to discipline, family building or work either way.

107987.aligns: The girls work hard at their band and make music together, and feelings are handled with honesty and care.
107987.concerns: Love is framed mainly as self-expression and personal discovery; family, children and duty to others are not part of its concerns.

114791.aligns: The heroes refuse to give up across repeated failures, plan carefully and fight to secure a better world for those who come after.
114791.concerns: Its stress on chosen bonds and personal will says little about family lines or children.

30418.aligns: Ginko approaches strange phenomena like a careful naturalist, observing and solving problems practically, and rural villages keep their own ways.
30418.concerns: Its ideal is humble coexistence with nature rather than mastering it, which sits apart from the tradition's drive to build and expand.

69325.aligns: A man goes back to protect at-risk children and keeps working the problem with clear thinking and persistence, aided by adults who step up.
69325.concerns: The focus is rescue and friendship more than family building, though protecting children is at its heart.

31303.aligns: Joe shows fierce grit and self-denial, training and cutting weight to rise from the slums through sheer effort.
31303.concerns: He spends himself completely on the ring and turns away from love and a future, so sacrifice serves passion rather than anything lasting.

85435.aligns: A neglected girl learns her worth, takes up a craft and comes to value caring for others and being cared for.
85435.concerns: The occult setting and focus on personal healing leave little to say about discipline, family lines or technology.

100557.aligns: It shows clearly how an abusive home harms a child and why children need safe, trustworthy adults.

107559.aligns: A perfectionist heroine learns to let real affection matter more than appearances.
107559.concerns: The story runs on fan service and a coercive, embarrassing bargain treated as fun, so pleasure is the engine of the message.

30047.aligns: A weak, lazy boy is trained hard to inherit a family's leadership, growing through discipline into someone who protects his own.
30047.concerns: The family being a mafia clan and fights settled by power muddy the picture of a worthy heritage.

30267.aligns: Some human characters choose to stay human and fight on rather than trade their humanity for power.
30267.concerns: The story revels in raw power and slaughter, and its tone leans toward nihilism, with little that is built or handed down.

105263.aligns: Outcasts stay loyal to each other and refuse to be used by those who want to exploit them.
105263.concerns: Its absurdist, cheerfully chaotic tone says little about work, family or building anything lasting.

105332.aligns: Two working adults build a caring, committed relationship while taking real pride in their product development work.
105332.concerns: The sensual focus is heavy and the story is more about acceptance and desire than about family or self-discipline.

30053.aligns: A delinquent grows up through hard training and self-sacrifice, earning his strength and learning to protect others.
30053.concerns: Power and fighting take center stage, and family or building for the future are only background.

86265.aligns: Fighters push past their limits through brutal training, and an old fighting style is passed down and earned.
86265.concerns: Corporate disputes settled by combat and a strong-man ethos make might the main measure of worth.

100991.aligns: Kei works relentlessly at her acting while caring for her younger siblings, so craft and family duty both carry weight.
100991.concerns: It warns that total immersion in art can cost a person their stability, and her home life is shown as precarious.

101942.aligns: Two travelers persist through a ruined Japan, seeking truth over comforting lies and staying loyal through great change.
101942.concerns: Science appears mostly as experiments on children and the human body, framing technology as something that dehumanizes.

86279.aligns: Romeo works hard to rise to leadership so he can change a hostile, divided school for the better.
86279.concerns: Its message favors breaking down group lines through romance more than communities keeping their own ways.

85395.aligns: Hard-working basketball players and persistent, supportive love help the leads grow up.
85395.concerns: A light sports romance with little to say about family building, thrift or technology either way.

85226.aligns: An overlooked father uses his new mechanical body to heal the sick and save lives, showing technology turned to human good.
85226.concerns: His family mostly disdains him, and the story's main concern is what makes a person human rather than building something lasting.

105641.aligns: Patient, everyday kindness lays the foundation for first love.
105641.concerns: A gentle school romance that touches little on family, work or technology.

30481.aligns: Space-debris workers do hard, unglamorous work that keeps humanity's expansion into space going, and the hero ends up building a family.

31474.aligns: It shows that love and loyalty are what keep people human under pressure.

107279.aligns: A poor boy grows through humble, thinking effort and hard training, partly to repay a single mother who sacrificed for him.
107279.concerns: Its focus is a sports career and team play, with family building in the background.

134369.aligns: A temple heir works to keep his vows, and sincere feeling is set above vanity.
134369.concerns: The comedy mostly cheers when temptation erodes his discipline, so self-control is played for laughs.

59211.aligns: A dedicated teen manga artist and his friends put in real work on their creative craft and help each other.
59211.concerns: A light parody comedy, so it touches family, technology and sacrifice only lightly.

30022.aligns: A former killer atones by protecting others, a family dojo's style is passed to students, and the story looks toward a new era and next generation.
30022.concerns: Its stress on found family over blood family and long stretches of combat are minor tensions.

117620.aligns: It rewards honest reckoning with past harm and choosing to keep living and writing after loss.
117620.concerns: Love is framed mainly as personal self-expression; family, children and duty to others are not its concern.

30909.aligns: A faint hope at the end suggests people can endure even total disaster.
30909.concerns: Science appears as a war weapon that turns on the living, and the horror leans toward cosmic dread rather than any constructive answer.

111403.aligns: Local belonging and community warmth grow into a committed love that points toward marriage.
111403.concerns: Fan service is a big part of the appeal, and work or discipline are not central.

144866.aligns: A daughter masters a traditional craft through strict apprenticeship to honor her father, showing a family legacy carried on by earned skill.
144866.concerns: Its focus is career mastery more than building a family of her own.

80217.aligns: A boy steps up to help a girl caring for her little brother, showing responsibility and children's need for trustworthy adults.
80217.concerns: Parents are largely absent or failing, and the story's ending is bittersweet.

74929.aligns: It shows using others to dull loneliness as hollow and pushes its characters toward honest self-knowledge.

86526.aligns: It questions killing for a cause and treats the search for happiness as a serious question.

60315.aligns: A proud rival matures through persistent effort into patient, committed love that ends in marriage.
60315.concerns: A light romcom, so work, children and family culture appear only lightly.

116170.aligns: A blind woman's independence and an officer's quiet care show dignity and attention to small moments.
116170.concerns: A gentle romance with little to say about work, family building or technology.

85793.aligns: It exposes a cruel, rigged hierarchy and its abuses of power.
85793.concerns: The heroine treats reckless gambling and the thrill of risk as life's highest pleasure, and the story celebrates that compulsion.

56736.aligns: A lonely young woman finds home in a family rebuilding itself, and a house and family ties are shown as worth sacrifice.
56736.concerns: The ideal is more found family than lineage, though restoring the family is central.

101724.aligns: It holds that no one should spend life alone, and companionship slowly grows into romance.
101724.concerns: Fun and fan service dominate, and discipline or family building play little part.

105791.aligns: A man shows real self-control and responsible care for a runaway, helping her return and face her family.
105791.concerns: The family she returns to is badly damaged, and the setup is an unusual one for parents to weigh.

111149.aligns: A family with its own name, traditions, training and head shapes its members, and the young couple builds a marriage by earning their place.

198372.aligns: Peoples from different worlds try to coexist through hard, practical diplomacy, and young heirs carry forward their families' legacies.

85388.aligns: Survival comes through loyalty, quick wits and refusing to abandon loved ones.

30010.aligns: Every wish has a price, so actions have costs, and a person's life matters to those around them.

38157.aligns: Kindness and persistence help a homeless girl make a home, and loyal love leads to lasting commitment.

85247.aligns: Two exorcists are told their child will save the world, and the story treats partnership, duty and future children as worth sacrifice.

30731.aligns: Characters make meaning through loyalty and survival in a violent world.
30731.concerns: Technology and power are mostly shown as tools of control, and the outlook is bleak.

102989.aligns: A young man thinks clearly under pressure and keeps trying until he protects his friends and home island.

114383.aligns: Families by blood and by upbringing both matter, and a hard-working son studies for top grades.

66413.aligns: A man takes responsibility for a child, and kids learn gratitude, thrift and honest work, with idleness played as a flaw.

104063.aligns: Friends stay loyal and seek the truth when an institution demands silence.

104503.aligns: A practical hero cuts through nonsense, protects a few true friends and uses advanced technology to solve problems.

126135.aligns: A girl fights her way out of a manor that grants every wish if she stays put, choosing painful reality over escapist fantasy.

103082.aligns: It shows cruelty coming back on those who commit it.

33438.aligns: Teens refuse to give up and fight to change a ruined future, protecting the generation that would live in it.

122063.aligns: A player masters a hard game through persistence, fair play and clever strategy, and the VR technology is shown positively.

43245.aligns: Players master a classical poetry card game through discipline, with effort beating talent and a living tradition handed down to children.

152404.aligns: Two students work hard toward a shared student council goal, and a lazy genius learns to try.

168468.aligns: A son carries on his father's legacy through hard training and loyalty, protecting others even when he is cast out.
168468.concerns: Technology appears mostly as a dangerous tool, and might decides most conflicts.

30894.aligns: An ordinary boy finds the courage to protect friends from many kinds of monsters.
30894.concerns: Harem fan service is central, and work, discipline or family building play little part.

30584.aligns: It shows obsession and lust for control destroying people.
30584.concerns: A bleak survival game where family is often a source of harm and little of the message points toward building anything.

57231.aligns: It rewards honest feelings and growing up through friendship and first love.
57231.concerns: A school romance with little to say about family, work or technology.

176740.aligns: A young man takes on raising an orphaned baby and builds a chosen family through loss and sacrifice.
